research.name: Canvas UI
research.note: Copy-in components that capture live DOM into a canvas so WebGL or WebGPU shaders can distort the page as fluid, fire or glass.

effects: live DOM captured as a shader texture through the HTML-in-canvas API (canvas layoutsubtree, drawElementImage)
pointer-driven fluid simulation that smears the page content under the cursor
every effect shipped as both a WebGL (GLSL) and a WebGPU (WGSL) build for six frameworks

unverified: Only the Liquid effect was seen, as frames of the README recording; the live site was not viewed running in a browser in this session.
The other components (Glass, Shatter, Blaze, Force Field and the rest) and the dual WebGL and WebGPU builds are taken from the README and docs text, not observed.
